blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Philippine prime minister and finance chief Cesar E.A. Virata died on Friday, Oct. 2, Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. (RCBC) announced. Virata was the bank’s corporate vice chairperson and a director at the time of his death. READ: ‘Cesar Virata, Life and Times’ He had served on its board since 1995 and held the corporate vice chairperson post for 26 years. “It is with deep sorrow that the Bank announces the passing of Mr. Cesar E.A. Virata,” RCBC said in a disclosure. The bank did not disclose the cause of death. Virata served as prime minister from 1981 to […]...
